title: Procurement of double door refrigerator and smart LED TV at MNTI Deep Bhavan Kolkata
summary: GeM two-packet bid for supply, installation and commissioning of one frost-free side-by-side refrigerator and two smart TVs for the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Kolkata.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, D-372/2, Taratala Road, Kolkata-700088

scope.item: Household refrigerating appliance as per IS 17550: frost-free, side-by-side door, 601-650 L, plain design, shades of grey
Television (TV) (V2): Smart TV, LED/OLED/QLED, more than 46 inch up to 54 inch, 4K UHD or higher

money.notes: GeM estimated bid value Rs 3,03,490. EMD not required. MII purchase preference: No. MSE purchase preference L1+15% up to 25% of quantity. ICT: 90% of product cost on delivery, minimum 10% allocated to installation/commissioning/testing within 10 days of site readiness.

period.warranty: 1 year from final acceptance (GeM ATC); refrigerator compressor 10 years or higher; TV comprehensive warranty 1 year or higher, display 3 years or higher

eligibility: Bidder minimum average annual turnover Rs 1 lakh (3 years); OEM average turnover Rs 12 lakh
3 years past experience in same/similar category; past performance 70% of bid quantity in one of last three financial years
No MSE or startup relaxation for experience and turnover
Documents: experience, past performance, bidder turnover, OEM authorization, OEM turnover, certificates requested in ATC; BIS licence and type test certificates
Bidder/OEM must have dedicated/toll-free service number and functional service centre in consignee state (carry-in warranty)
specs: Refrigerator: IS 17550, frost-free, side-by-side, total volume 601-650 L, BEE star rating NA for side-by-side, 1 year product warranty, 10 year compressor warranty; BIS Scheme-I mark
TV: smart TV, LED/OLED/QLED, >46 to 54 inch, audio 10W x 2 or higher, 4K UHD 3840x2160 or higher, brightness 300 nits or higher, BEE 1 star or higher; IS 616:2017 BIS registration (Scheme-II)
Scope: supply, installation, testing and commissioning; option clause +/-25% quantity
notes: Document is the 10-page GeM bid only; buyer-uploaded ATC referenced ('Click here to view the file') is not included. Listing title says 'double door refrigerator' at 'MNTI', but the GeM specification is a side-by-side refrigerator and the consignee is the Directorate office at Deep Bhavan, Kolkata (MNTI not mentioned). Bid end 25-12-2025 13:00, opening 13:30. Consignee is a named officer (name omitted).
